constraints: Current authorization before reserve, replay or status; revoked authority cannot use idempotency as a bypass
Lock/re-read all mutable authority facts in consistent order; real multi-session evidence remains required
Trusted authenticator/authenticated context plus coherent protected claims; no actor/key/time/config override
Immutable reservation identity and expiry; exact replay neither renews nor duplicates audit
Private disabled-by-default bounded synthetic config; no caller-controlled configuration authority
RLS and explicit table/column/function ACLs; no direct service-role manifest/config writes
Minimal fixed reservation and configuration audit events only, same-transaction rollback on failure
Truthful reserved/expired status, no claim of bytes, scanning, clearance, release or durable denials
lead_scope: Only the reservation/configuration/authorization/audit database subset is currently allocated. ADR-003's remaining transport, provider storage, scan/clearance and future exact-version mechanisms require later bounded implementation and independent review.
owner_decisions: Provisional development refinements recorded under OD-013, cross-referencing OD-001/003 and future DOC-001 authority. No live owner approval inferred.
evidence_limits: Read-only contract review, no code security certification, runtime execution, cloud operation or deployment. Actual frozen migration patch review remains mandatory.
